text.0: How VATRA handles your account data, why it is needed, and how you can manage it.

This policy explains how VATRA processes information when you browse the website, create an account, sign in, communicate, publish content, participate in communities or post listings. It describes why data is used, which outside services are involved, how information is retained and your rights.
VATRA does not sell registration information to advertisers, and its pages do not include advertising pixels for profiling.

VATRA also processes profile details, posts, comments, messages, uploaded photos and videos, listings, visibility settings and necessary technical information. Who can access content depends on its type and visibility settings. A phone number and payment details are not required to register.

Your email address is used for account confirmation, sign-in and password recovery, and may be used for account-security messages. The first and last name entered at registration appear to other VATRA members on your profile and next to your posts. Date of birth, email and gender are not displayed publicly. Gender is optional; you may choose a value or leave it unspecified. Other details are used to create your account, verify sign-ins and protect against unauthorized access.

Depending on the information and circumstances, processing may rely on your consent, the need to provide VATRA under its terms, compliance with legal requirements or legitimate interests of users and the platform owner where permitted by law.

VATRA uses external services including Supabase (registration, sign-in, database and files), GitHub Pages (website hosting), Cloudflare Turnstile (bot protection for forms) and jsDelivr (delivery of technical libraries). These providers may receive IP addresses, browser information and request details. Supabase also processes account information and content you make available on VATRA. If you have questions about data processing, contact

VATRA's main Supabase project is hosted in the Central EU region (Frankfurt, Germany), where its primary database, authentication and file storage operate. Other providers or their contractors may technically process certain data in other countries, depending on the service. Passwords are transmitted to the authentication service over HTTPS and are not embedded in public website source code.

Account information is retained while the account is used and the information is needed to provide VATRA features. Posts, photos, comments and other content remain until deleted or until processing is no longer necessary. Some information may be kept longer where required by law or needed to protect rights and security. You can clear session and preference information stored in your browser using its settings.

Retention periods for technical logs, service records and backups depend on each provider's settings and policies. After information is deleted, some copies may remain temporarily in backup systems. To request access to, correction of or deletion of your data, email vatra.support@gmail.com. We may need to verify account ownership to protect your information.

Depending on applicable law, you may request access to your data, request correction or deletion, object to certain processing, withdraw consent where it is the relevant legal basis, or contact the competent authorities.

meta.description: Marketplace rules for sellers and buyers: permitted listings, prohibitions, restrictions and appeals.
meta.og:title: VATRA Commerce Rules
meta.og:description: Marketplace rules for sellers and buyers: permitted listings, prohibitions, restrictions and appeals.

text.0: These rules cover all VATRA Marketplace offers: sale, exchange, rental and free transfer, as well as related photos, descriptions and communications. Participants are responsible for lawful conduct, the right to dispose of items and consumer rights. Prohibitions also apply to attempts to circumvent the rules through different categories or messages.

Each new listing first enters VATRA's manual moderation queue with a Pending review status. It is not visible to other users until approved. A moderator reviews the title, description, category and photos before approving the listing or rejecting it with a reason. Sellers can appeal a rejection. VATRA may also hide or remove listings and restrict Marketplace access for rule violations. Repeated or serious violations may lead to additional account measures under the Terms of Service and applicable law. If a decision is mistaken or you find a violation, contact support with the listing URL or ID and an explanation. Do not send confidential information.
The following categories are not admitted to the catalogue. Examples are not exhaustive.
Animals, natural resources and protected land
Listings, photos and transaction-related messages must comply with the VATRA Terms of Service. Spam, threats, harassment, fraud and child exploitation are prohibited.

Sex toys, pornography, sexual enhancement products, condoms and lubricants, worn underwear and sexualized imagery are not permitted. Images of nude children or sexual acts are never acceptable in listings.

Alcoholic drinks and kits for making alcohol are not permitted on the VATRA Marketplace. Ordinary glasses, coasters, coolers and books about beverages are allowed if the listing does not promote alcohol sales. Goods intended to advertise alcohol sales are not permitted.
Trading organs, teeth, nails, blood, urine, semen or other human tissue or fluids is prohibited. Ordinary wigs and hairpieces are outside this prohibition.

Devices specifically configured for pirated access, unlawful circumvention, signal interference or covert eavesdropping are prohibited. Lawful remotes, keyboards and ordinary functioning electronics are permitted.

Unlawful restrictions on buyers, tenants or sellers based on race, ethnicity, skin colour, citizenship, national origin, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or marital status, disability, health or genetic characteristics are prohibited. This also applies to housing listings and negotiations.

Documents and copies, forgeries, cash, cryptocurrencies, bank cards, cheques, payment instruments, counterfeiting equipment and offers of lending, insurance, banking and other financial services are prohibited.

Listings for casinos, monetary bets, lotteries, pools, poker and other gambling for money or valuables, including cryptocurrency, are prohibited. Ordinary board games without gambling stakes are outside this rule.

Do not offer toxic, corrosive, explosive or highly flammable substances, hazardous pesticides, asbestos or chemical precursors whose circulation threatens safety. Legality alone does not establish eligibility for the catalogue.

Offers involving human trafficking, unlawful smuggling, forced labour, escort services, prostitution, paid sexual services or sexualized shows are prohibited. Child sexual abuse material is prohibited. Matchmaking and recruitment are not catalogue goods.

Marketplace is not a job board. Do not post recruitment, multilevel marketing or get-rich-quick schemes. Lawful employment opportunities may be discussed in permitted VATRA areas under the general terms.
12. Animals, natural resources and protected land

Live animals, animal body parts, products from protected species, raw fish, meat and eggs, and real estate within ecological reserves are prohibited. Veterinary medicines and services are not admitted. Cages, toys, collars and other lawful pet accessories are permitted.

Medical devices, disease diagnostic kits, contact lenses, corrective glasses, thermometers, first aid kits, breast pumps, injections and cosmetic procedures, treatment claims, medical or infant nutrition formulas and supplements including steroids, hormones, protein powders and vitamins are prohibited. Ordinary fitness accessories and pregnancy or ovulation tests are permitted if otherwise compliant.

Phishing, false prices and product claims, payment scams, review manipulation, shocking violent imagery and material promoting racial hatred or extremism are prohibited. Do not shame a person's appearance or health to sell products.

Each listing must offer a specific item, permitted real estate or the free transfer of an eligible item. News, memes, fundraising, lost-and-found posts and requests to buy without an item on offer belong outside the catalogue.
Prescription and over-the-counter medicines, narcotics, cannabis and cannabis products, and paraphernalia intended for drug use are prohibited.

Goods withdrawn from sale, recalled by a manufacturer or banned for safety reasons may not be sold. Check children's products, furniture and toys particularly carefully. If unsure, verify the model and batch against manufacturer or regulator notices.
Items obtained through theft, fraud or other unlawful means are prohibited. Sellers must have the right to dispose of the property.

Sales of accounts, service access, digital subscriptions, downloadable files, activation codes, followers or engagement are prohibited. Genuine physical discs and ordinary electronic devices are permitted when lawfully sold.

Counterfeit branded goods, unlicensed copies of software, music, books or video, and other goods infringing copyright or trademarks are prohibited. Photos and descriptions must respect third-party rights.
Tobacco, cigarettes, electronic cigarettes, nicotine products and paraphernalia specifically intended for their use are prohibited.
Do not offer used cosmetics or cosmetics without their original packaging. New properly packaged products are eligible if otherwise compliant.

Unlawful, recalled or unsafe vehicle parts and accessories are prohibited. Lawful safe components are permitted when their origin and condition are accurately disclosed. Additional restrictions for specific parts may be established separately.
Weapons, ammunition, explosives and specialized components or equipment intended for their unlawful use are prohibited. This applies to sales, exchanges and free transfers.
These listing categories are not permitted on the VATRA Marketplace. The restriction applies regardless of payment method, transfer arrangement or listing category.
Listings offering tickets to events for sale, resale or transfer are not permitted on the VATRA Marketplace.
Gift cards, certificates and vouchers may not be offered for sale, exchange or free transfer on the VATRA Marketplace.
Listings offering the sale, transfer or rehoming of live animals are not permitted on the VATRA Marketplace.
Service listings are not permitted on the VATRA Marketplace. Property rental is a separate listing type and is not part of the general services category.

Provide the accurate price, location, condition and defects. Use your own or authorized photos. Do not duplicate listings to manipulate the catalogue. VATRA does not process payments, arrange delivery or guarantee transactions. Verify goods and sellers, never share passwords, codes or banking details, and avoid suspicious links. Statutory consumer rights remain intact.
